audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradicted this page's own prose: rows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 were given to Singed or 'Skill' while whys[1] through whys[5] each describe Shen winning that stage, and the two-item row was given to Singed while whys[6] says the duel is risky for both and to play teamfights.
audit.why: Shen wins 52.96% over 1,182 games and the packet chart reads Skill / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Skill. The already-audited Singed side follows the packet and moved its two-item stage to Skill, so this side has to match or mirror-fix.js overwrites it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 -> Shen at 6/10, row 6 -> Skill. Row 0 already Skill. Proposed as matched full+content pairs plus ratings in one atomic group.

audit.why: Shadow Dash at 2-3, Stand United at 6, Iceborn Gauntlet, and his Insanity Potion window are the right four and correctly labelled — Iceborn's slow genuinely punishes a post-Fling escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned that Mega Adhesive grounds — the single most important interaction in this lane, because grounding means Shadow Dash cannot be cast at all while you stand in the goo. wants.you[0] instead told you to taunt during his Fling animation so he 'throws you into your own Spirit's Refuge zone', which is not something the kits support.
audit.why: Riot's Mega Adhesive text: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it', and the kit carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'). Shen's entire pattern is a 600-range dash on 18s and 150 energy; a Singed who lands the vial first removes it outright. Riot's Fling text also states that a target flung into Mega Adhesive is rooted — his only hard lockdown, and the page never said so.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now tells you to step off the goo before dashing; dontsFull[1].d carries the Fling-into-adhesive root; report[5].t, phases[1].why and breakdown.cooldowns carry both.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d described Fling only as 'his flip' with no numbers.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1 falling to 8s and only 125 range, so he has to walk into you — that is what makes the window playable. Mega Adhesive at 17s is the longer and more punishable cooldown.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten with Fling 10s->8s and 125 range, Mega Adhesive 17s, Shadow Dash 18s / 150 energy.
